en: Kilesasaṅkiliṭṭhaduka (The Dyad of Defiled by the Defilements)
Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled, a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither non-defiled nor defiled, a state that is neither non-defiled nor defiled arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled, and which is neither defilement nor non-defilement, there arises a state that is neither defiled nor non-defiled by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … three. (Abbreviated.
Nine in the case of root; … pe … nine in the case of non-disappearance (*avigata*).
